obtained_by: AI agent (Claude Sonnet 5.5, subagent of the L54b3a batch) on behalf of roberto.carmeli@gmail.com
obtained_from: Downloaded with curl from Diodes Incorporated's own host (www.diodes.com), not from a distributor or a mirror, byte for byte as served. The /spice/download/<id>/<name> route selects the file by the NUMERIC ID: the name in the URL is not checked (ID 2541 with the name BC847B.spice.txt returned the MMBT5551 model). The ID of each file was therefore confirmed by its served Content-Type name (name="<PART>.spice.txt") and by reading the first lines of the file.
license_notes: Manufacturer datasheet and manufacturer-published SPICE model, redistributed here unmodified for engineering traceability only. Copyright remains Diodes Incorporated. The model file carries the vendor's own AS-IS warranty disclaimer, reproduced unaltered.
why_not_nexperia: Nexperia was the first choice and publishes SPICE models for these types (its product pages list a BC847 SPICE model dated 2024-04-05 and a BAT54 SPICE model dated 2020-08-25, per search-result snippets, not seen by me). It could not be used: assets.nexperia.com (tried: /documents/spice-model/BC847.txt and BC847B.txt; assets.nexperia.cn/.../BAT54.txt) answers HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (Akamai) to curl, and www.nexperia.com / www.nexperia.cn product pages answer 403 to the WebFetch tool. I did not try to get around the filter (same finding as vendor/diodes/nexperia/BAV199/PROVENANCE.json). onsemi's route https://www.onsemi.com/download/models/lib/bc847b.lib returned HTTP 200 text/html of 304530 bytes, i.e. a web page, not a model (the soft-404 already recorded for 2n5551); nothing was kept. Diodes Incorporated publishes a model and the datasheet for each of the same types, so Diodes' own files are used, one manufacturer per device.

model_declared_metadata: *SRC=BC847A;DI_BC847A;BJTs NPN; Si;  45.0V  0.100A  300MHz   Diodes Inc. No DATE or VERSION line.
vendor_file_defect: The file has a bare line 'BJTs' (line 18, between the '*SRC=' comment and the .MODEL), the wrapped tail of the comment without its '*'. ngspice 47 reads it as a B source and exits 1: 'mal formed B source instance: bjts'. The vendor original is left as served; the models/ copy turns it into '*BJTs' (models/bjt_npn/bc847a.provenance.json).
